description: Removal of condition  4 (opening hours) attached to planning permission PL/2481/24 dated 31/1/2025 for Change of Use from a restaurant (Class E (b)) at nos. 2 & 3 Station Parade to a retail shop (Class E (a)) and to amalgamate with the existing retail shop at no. 1 Station Parade. Demolition of existing single storey rear extensions at nos. 2 & 3, single storey extension, and detached building at rear of no. 1 and erection of a single storey rear extension to all three units
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: Application Form, Noise Impact Assessment

<p><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">Works should not begin until a Delivery and Servicing Plan has first been submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing to be agreed.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">The delivery and service plan shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details for the lifetime of the development.</span></p>

<p><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">No development shall take place, including any works of demolition, until a Construction Method Statement has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority in accordance with the format and guidance provided by Transport for London – www.tfl.gov.uk. The Construction Method Statement shall provide for:&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 35.45pt; line-height: 16.1px;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 18.4px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">a) Parking of vehicles of site operatives/visitors.</span><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 35.45pt; line-height: 16.1px;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 18.4px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">b) HGV access to site – loading and unloading of plant and materials.</span><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 35.45pt; line-height: 16.1px;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 18.4px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">c) Number of HGV’s anticipated.</span><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 35.45pt; line-height: 16.1px;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 18.4px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">d) Storage of plant and materials used in constructing the development.</span><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 35.45pt; line-height: 16.1px;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 18.4px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">e) Programme of work and phasing.</span><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 35.45pt; line-height: 16.1px;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 18.4px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">f) Site layout plan.</span><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 35.45pt; line-height: 16.1px;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 18.4px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">g) Highway condition (before, during, after).</span><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 35.45pt; line-height: 16.1px;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 18.4px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">h) Measures to control dust and dirt during construction.</span><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 35.45pt; line-height: 16.1px;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 18.4px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">i) A scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction works; and</span><o:p></o:p></span></p><p><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 14px;"></span><span style="font-size: 14px;"></span><span style="font-size: 14px;"></span><span style="font-size: 14px;"></span><span style="font-size: 14px;"></span><span style="font-size: 14px;"></span><span style="font-size: 14px;"></span><span style="font-size: 14px;"></span></span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Construction Method Statement, or any amendment or variation to it as may be agreed in writing by the local planning authority.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-family: Swiss721BT-Roman, sans-serif; font-size: 14.6667px;">Prior to commencement of development, details of an adequate cycle rack system and their dimensions shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The cycle storage shall be made available prior to occupation and shall be retained thereafter.&nbsp; LB Harrow do not support the provision of vertical cycle storage as this excludes less able people from being able to securely store their cycle.</span></p>

<p>Within three months of the approved&nbsp;development, a post‑installation Noise and Vibration Verification Report shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The report shall demonstrate that all noise and vibration mitigation measures identified within the approved Noise Impact Assessment have been fully implemented and are performing as intended.</p><p>The report shall include measured noise and vibration levels at the nearest residential receptors and shall confirm compliance with the assessment criteria approved as part of the application.</p><p>Where the report identifies any shortfall in performance or exceedance of the approved criteria, additional mitigation measures shall be implemented within a timeframe agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. A further verification report confirming the effectiveness of the additional mitigation shall thereafter be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</p>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
